status_note: P5.1-B full real run completed: 7 candidates evaluated by repeated subject-grouped CV (5-fold x 3 repeats, seeds 11/22/33, group=subject_id) on the P4a v0.1 primary cohort (50,060 snapshots / 60 subjects / 5,006 records). Selected calibrated_linear_svm (record_macro_f1_mean 0.9452) via the frozen selection ladder: within-margin tie with logistic_regression (0.9424, margin 0.005), tie-break 1 record_balanced_acc_mean 0.9429 vs 0.9418. Feature ablation run for top-2 x 5 groups (all-group reused from round 1). Candidate frozen as popu_research_candidate_p5_1_v0.1 (joblib 16,097 B, independent reload predict/predict_proba smoke OK, classes_order_matches=true). Full suite 115 tests green. Artifacts verified (OOF 1,051,260 rows, record 105,126, per_subject 420, per_class 35, fold_repeat 105, ablation 2x5).
task: fixed-posture 5-class subject-isolated candidate comparison via repeated subject-grouped cross-validation

columns.label: posture
columns.record_id_from: sample_id via the P4a contract popu-tactilus::<source_relative_path>#frame=<N>; the 10 snapshots of one JSON share the same source_relative_path

preprocessing.principle: imputer/scaler are always inside each candidate Pipeline and are fitted per fold on that fold's training subjects only, never on the full table
preprocessing.imputation: SimpleImputer(strategy=median) for the 22 NaN empty/WARN rows (principal_axis/anisotropy)
preprocessing.scaling: StandardScaler for distance/gradient-based estimators (logistic_regression, centroid, calibrated_linear_svm, knn)

evaluation_protocol.seeds_are_repeats: one subject-grouped fold set is generated per seed in the list, giving exactly 3 repeats; all candidates share the same fold sets
evaluation_protocol.all_candidates_share_folds: every candidate is evaluated on the exact same subject folds (same seeds/config) so rankings are comparable
evaluation_protocol.preprocessing_per_fold: only fitted on training subjects of each fold
evaluation_protocol.metrics_per_repeat: each repeat computes metrics separately on its own out-of-fold samples; mean/std across the 3 repeats are reported, never a pooled 150k-row score
evaluation_protocol.no_unseen_popu_test_claim: all 60 PoPu subjects were already used as dev OOF or held-out in P5 v0.1, so there is no re-nameable 'never-seen' PoPu test. P5.1 ranks candidates with repeated grouped CV; P5 v0.1 held-out results stay as historical first-round exploration evidence.

model_selection.criterion_note: record-level macro-F1 mean across the 3 repeats is the PRIMARY ranking caliber (P5.1-B 三)
model_selection.scope: grouped-CV out-of-fold predictions only; never reads any historical held-out test
model_selection.margin_note: candidates within 0.005 record macro-F1 of the top are treated as statistically tied; the fixed tie-break ladder then decides, complexity only as the final tie-break

evaluation_levels.snapshot: per-snapshot OOF predictions with repeat/fold_id/sample_id/group_id/y_true/y_pred/confidence/per-class proba__<label> traceability
evaluation_levels.record: mean-probability aggregation over the 10 snapshots of each PoPu record per repeat (record_id = source_relative_path); label/group conflicts are rejected; PRIMARY ranking caliber
evaluation_levels.subject: per-subject record-level accuracy/macro-F1 mean+std across repeats; worst subject (lowest accuracy_mean) flagged

feature_ablation.round2: top-2 round-1 candidates (by record_macro_f1_mean) only; the 'all' group reuses the identical round-1 results
feature_ablation.no_cartesian_product: round 2 is top-2 models x 5 groups, never every candidate x every group

candidate_freeze.condition: after the full real run and artifact verification, the selected candidate is refit on the FULL primary cohort (all 60 subjects)
candidate_freeze.name: popu_research_candidate_p5_1_v0.1
candidate_freeze.label: PoPu research candidate — a research-stage result on public PoPu data only; NOT a product model and NOT externally validated
save: training data version (P4a v0.1 primary cohort, 50,060 snapshots / 60 subjects)
candidate_freeze.smoke_test: independent load + predict/predict_proba on a held slice after joblib reload

runtime_budget.note: a one-fold smoke-timing pass runs per candidate first (fit on fold-0 train, predict on fold-0 val) to record fit/inference time and pickle size; a candidate whose estimated full run (one-fold fit time x n_folds) exceeds this budget is marked SKIPPED with the recorded reason. Default budget is generous so no candidate is skipped under normal conditions.

external_validation.limitation: P5.1 cannot restore an unseen PoPu test. Real external confirmation is deferred to SLP/PressurePose/PMD tasks where applicable and to future self-developed synchronized data; those datasets must be evaluated separately and never row-joined with PoPu.
